kebab_example: aliyun polardb delete-agentic-db-project --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id pagc-bp1abcdef1234567 --tenant-id t-4b83e0da66674951 --project-id proj-a1b2c3d4e5f6 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAgenticDBProject

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgenticDB cluster. The ID must start with pagc-. You can obtain the ID by calling CreateDBCluster and setting AgenticDbType to dedicated. Regular cluster IDs that start with pc- are not supported
parameters.help_zh: AgenticDB 集群 ID，必须以 pagc- 开头。通过 CreateDBCluster（AgenticDbType=dedicated）获取；普通 pc- 集群 ID 不适用
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant to which the project belongs. You can obtain the ID after calling CreateAgenticDBTenant to create a tenant
parameters.help_zh: 归属 Tenant ID。通过 CreateAgenticDBTenant 创建租户后获取
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the project to be deleted. You can obtain the ID after calling CreateAgenticDBProject to create a project
parameters.help_zh: 目标 Project ID。通过 CreateAgenticDBProject 创建项目后获取
parameters.name: project_id
